snippet.title: Frogger and the Rumbling Ruins｜Update Trailer Ver.1.2.0
snippet.description:
NEW UPDATE! 
Frogger is off to the Sky Ruins to find the secret of the final stone tablet in Frogger and the Rumbling Ruins.
Help him navigate the gravity switch to conquer the terrain, and through teleportation portals to rescue all the missing froglets. 
And with a new aviator outfit, records, and more to discover, this is the best update yet!
